decision: Do not promote: changing schema field order alone did not correct the known semantic admissions.
experiment: Same recorded revised SYSTEM and six original v2 payloads; field types, validation and output ceiling unchanged. Unit reason before verdict, request reason before disposition, overall verdict last.

limits: One stochastic sample per previously seen candidate; this is not an accuracy or false-positive population estimate.
No writer, retrieval, browser, saved-matter operation or semantic repair was run.
The prior baseline/revised samples were interleaved; this six-call run used case order 01 through 06. Caching and timing were not controlled.
Valid source references demonstrate receipt reliability, not whether the referenced evidence supports the semantic judgment.
